summary: United Rentals, Inc. and its subsidiary United Rentals (North America), Inc., as co-registrants, filed an 8-K regarding Amendment No. 18 to its Third Amended and Restated Receivables Purchase Agreement. The amendment involves United Rentals Receivables LLC II as seller, the company as collection agent, and multiple purchasers and banks including Liberty Street Funding, Gotham Funding, GTA Funding, Reliant Trust, and various financial institutions as agents. This is a routine debt facility amendment, not a special situation. No deal terms or special-situation mechanics are present; the filing is a standard current report on a material definitive agreement related to an off-balance-sheet arrangement.
